title: 第三章 大叔随便玩玩啦第四章 给钱儿子也是可以谈的
lines: “不看了，心肝脾肺肾都痛！”
不少人离开了，没有什么比这种等死更让人憋屈的。
远在千里之外的北京，一个坐着轮椅、皮肤白皙的小姑娘正紧张的盯着屏幕，小手因为过于用力而发白，“能赢吗？应该没希望了吧，就跟自己一样，我就知道上天不会眷顾我们这样的人。”
听着小姑娘的自言自语，门外母亲在垂泪，父亲忍不住叹息，女儿有神经性行走障碍，无数次治疗都没有效果，随着年纪成长也越来越自闭，电脑成了唯一的伙伴，好不容易打听到美国现在有最新的治疗方案，可是她却拒绝配合。
就在此时，战场上，killer的两队飞龙分散了，一组正面牵制，一组绕到了人族基地的矿区……
朱镇模灌了一大口咖啡，……速溶的好难喝，就这么点飞龙还分散，真是不知死啊，要是连甩飞龙都防不住，look真可以退役了，这跟在库里面前秀三分没什么两样。
看着虽然兵分两路，却依然不断聚拢成团的飞龙，不但朱镇钟，很多观众似乎都意识到一件事儿，可这能行？
…是的——双线甩飞龙，只存在于理论和传说中的，虫族核弹技术！
朱镇钟看向killer的包房，键盘鼠标的点击声如同爆豆一样，小孩的眼神锐利如刀，炫的刺目，apm瞬间飚到了490，作为的对手的look第一时间反应过来，尽管意识到了，。可是他仍然不敢相信！
甩飞龙本身就是是虫族的选手高难度操作，要把一队12只飞龙凝聚在一点，保持不散，同时攻击之后要迅速拉回，让攻击叠加在一点，控制稍微一疏忽就会散掉，一次失误就是全军覆没，要知道的，他面对的是顶尖人族选手，这甩飞龙的难度本身就无限大.
而现在双线是什么鬼？，
除非是两个职业选手同时操作！
这，只有上帝能做到，look根本不相信！
朱镇钟也不信，小家伙，总是有不切实际的幻想。
人族基地由防御塔保护，look的部队全力扑向正面的飞龙，正面的飞龙不断甩尾拉扯，同时拉开距离并不硬拼，可三秒之后，另外一面战场，人族基地的防空塔和农民已经空了。
整个网吧仿佛中了时间静止的魔法，所有人目瞪口呆的看着这从未出现的奇迹！
两对飞龙没有散，如同训练有素的士兵精准的完成了致命打击，这，是星海争霸历史上的神级操作。
这一刻，世界都因为这个操作而安静下来。
而这一操作也直接击溃了look的心理防线，两边飞龙的牵制不断蚕食人族的领地，look知道不能拖下去了，所有部队冲向虫族基地，这是最冷静的判断，换家，人族的拆家速度更快！
而在这拖延的过程中，killer的第三队飞龙也憋出来了，这次他没有避战，三队飞龙合体，一击杀出。
一击……
随着一声爆响，look的影飞编队瞬间化成乌有，……三队飞龙一起甩……伤害叠加已经爆破天际。
这是虫族的第二枚核弹，另一个传说，一种只存在于训练中的自娱自乐。
content_en:
"If you don't watch it, your heart, liver, spleen, lungs and kidneys will hurt!"
Many people left. There is nothing more frustrating than waiting to die.
Thousands of miles away in Beijing, a fair-skinned girl in a wheelchair was staring nervously at the screen. Her little hands turned white from exerting too much force. "Can I win? There is no hope. Just like me, I know that God will not favor people like us."
Listening to the little girl talking to herself, the mother was crying outside the door, and the father couldn't help but sigh. His daughter had a neurological walking disorder, and countless treatments had no effect. As she grew older, she became more and more autistic, and the computer became her only companion. She finally found out that the United States now has the latest treatment plan, but she refused to cooperate.
At this moment, Killer's two teams of flying dragons dispersed on the battlefield. One team was restraining them head-on, while the other team went around to the mining area of the human base...
Zhu Zhenmo took a big sip of coffee,... the instant coffee tasted terrible. It was just a little bit of flying dragon and it was scattered. It was so desperate. If he couldn't even prevent the flying dragon, Look could really retire. It was no different from showing off a three-pointer in front of Curry.
Huh...
Looking at the flying dragons that although divided into two groups, kept gathering into a group, not only Zhu Zhenzhong, but also many viewers seemed to realize one thing, but is this possible?
...Yes - double-threaded flying dragon, a Zerg nuclear bomb technology that only exists in theory and legend!
Zhu Zhenzhong looked at Killer's private room. The clicks of the keyboard and mouse were like exploding beans. The child's eyes were as sharp as knives and dazzling. The APM reached 490 in an instant. His opponent's look reacted immediately, even though he was aware of it. But he still couldn't believe it!
Flying dragon slinging itself is a difficult operation for Zerg players. They have to gather a team of 12 flying dragons at one point and keep them together. After attacking at the same time, they must quickly pull back so that the attacks are superimposed on one point. If the control is slightly neglected, they will be scattered. One mistake will be annihilated. You must know that he is facing top human players, and the difficulty of slinging flying dragons is infinite.
And what the hell is the double line now? ,
Unless two professional players operate at the same time!
Only God can do this, look doesn’t believe it at all!
Zhu Zhenzhong didn't believe it either. The little guy always had unrealistic fantasies.
The human base was protected by defense towers. Look's troops pounced on the flying dragon in front with all their strength. The flying dragon in the front kept flicking and pulling, and at the same time they kept the distance away without force. But three seconds later, on the other side of the battlefield, the human base's air defense towers and farmers were already empty.
The entire Internet cafe seemed to be under the spell of time standing still, and everyone was stunned to see this miracle that had never happened before!
The two pairs of flying dragons did not scatter, just like well-trained soldiers accurately completing the fatal blow. This is a god-level operation in the history of Star Sea Hegemony.
At this moment, the world became quiet because of this operation.
This operation also directly defeated Look's psychological defense line. The containment of the flying dragons on both sides continued to encroach on the human territory. Look knew that he could not drag it out any longer. All the troops rushed to the Zerg base. This was the calmest judgment. If he changed his family, the human family would be demolished faster!
During the delay, Killer's third team of flying dragons also came out. This time he did not avoid the battle. The three teams of flying dragons merged and killed him in one blow.
One blow...
With a loud explosion, Look's shadow flying formation instantly vanished into thin air...the three groups of flying dragons flung together...the damage stack had exploded into the sky.
This was the Zerg's second nuclear bomb, another legend, a self-entertainment that existed only in training.
